subject: Joint POC funding + marketplace trial SKU promotion
messages:
From: Rebecca Lang <rebecca@cloudwave.io>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot request: joint POC + marketplace trial SKU

Hi Vivek —

Thanks again for the quick call this morning. CloudWave is excited to validate a joint POC that bundles our observability adapter with Redwood’s hosted runtime. Quick summary of asks on our side:

- 90-day POC starting Sept 6, joint PR/marketing mention if POC metrics look good
- Trial SKU for Marketplace so we can offer customers a 30-day free tier through AWS/GCP listing
- $25k pilot funding to cover integration engineering and joint demos (CloudWave will contribute $10k)
- Metering integration checklist and entitlement mapping for Trial SKU routing

Can you confirm Redwood’s ability to provide trial SKU entitlements via AWS private offer or GCP trial listing, and whether you can commit pilot credits? We’d like a mutual action plan by EOD next Tuesday.

Attaching a preliminary MOU (pilot_MOU_CloudWave_Redwood.pdf) and a short promo SKU proposal.

Thanks — looking forward to moving fast.

Rebecca Lang
Head of Alliances, CloudWave
rebecca@cloudwave.io
+1 415 555 0198

Attachments: pilot_MOU_CloudWave_Redwood.pdf, promo_sku_matrix.csv

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: Rebecca Lang <rebecca@cloudwave.io>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 24 Aug 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request: joint POC + marketplace trial SKU

Rebecca —

Really appreciate the concise ask and the MOU. High level response and next steps from Redwood:

- We can commit up to $15k in pilot credits (covers hosted runtime + telemetry ingestion) contingent on a short MOU and a 90-day results review.
- We support issuing trial entitlements via both AWS Private Offers and GCP trial listings; we will need partner listing metadata (logo, SKU description, support contact) and metering mapping.
- Karthik, can you confirm engineering ETA for the metering shim and whether we can expose a trial SKU that maps to our trial ribbon?
- Olga, can you take point on the legal MOU review and coordinate a short SOW addendum for the pilot?
- Ben, would appreciate if you can draft a high-level mutual action plan and confirm go/no-go dates for joint marketing PR.

I'll loop Marketplace partner ops once we have the checklist filled. For timing — if Karthik/OIga can turn around the checklist and SOW draft by Monday COB, we can get DocuSign out Monday night and start the POC Sept 6 as requested.

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai

Date: Mon, 27 Aug 2028 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request: joint POC + marketplace trial SKU

Vivek / Rebecca —

Quick technical note from infra/engineering:

- Metering shim: we can implement a lightweight adaptor that exports usage records to the marketplace metering endpoint (AWS Metering Service / GCP Marketplace). Estimated dev time: 5 dev-days to a working prototype, 2 more days for hardened retry logic and idempotency.
- We will need: sample usage dimensions (concurrent sessions, tokens ingested, inference minutes), SKU price ladder for post-trial billing, and the test account IDs for sandbox metering.
- Attachment: marketplace_metering_checklist.xlsx (fields filled where we know defaults).

Two asks for CloudWave:
1) Confirm which usage dimensions map to your product-level entitlements (CloudWave adapter events vs aggregate inference).
2) Sandbox accounts for AWS and GCP (test AMI/project numbers) — we need those to validate the metering flow.

If we get those by Thursday we can ship the prototype by Aug 31 and run an internal smoke test before the DocuSign execution.

— Karthik

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: Rebecca Lang <rebecca@cloudwave.io>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, Marketplace Partner Ops <mp-ops@aws-marketplace.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request: joint POC + marketplace trial SKU

Team and Rebecca —

All good updates. Quick commercial confirmation and operational asks before we push to DocuSign:

- Redwood will provide $15k in pilot credits, CloudWave will contribute $10k, and we approve a joint PR mention if the metrics agreed in the MOU are met.
- Legal (Olga): please review the attached MOU and add a one-paragraph SLA for pilot support window (Mon-Fri 9–6 PT) and an escalation path.
- Karthik: proceed with the metering shim prototype. Please keep retry window <= 24h and document idempotency tokens in the checklist.
- Ben: draft MAP and a simple co-marketing timeline (draft attached as promo_sku_matrix.csv).
- Marketplace ops (copied): can you confirm whether AWS requires a separate Private Offer acceptance window for the SKU? Also share the DocuSign powerform link you prefer.

Rebecca — once Olga and Karthik confirm, we will send the finalized MOU via DocuSign (link below) and aim to activate the trial SKU in AWS/GCP sandboxes by Sept 4.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcd-1234
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890

Thanks — Vivek
